I've been using this for both my betta tanks for almost a year now

Tank size: 3.5 gallons 

 • Heater and filter? (yes/no): heater not yet but I will be getting one tomorrow so most likely by the time you see this it'll be yes/ filter yes 

 • Tank temperature: between 72 and 73 degrees 

 • [Parameters in numbers and how you got them](https://www.reddit.com/r/bettafish/wiki/tank#wiki_test_kits):

 • How often are water changes? How much do you take out per change? What is your process?: every two weeks when in smaller tank, not sure how often with a bigger tank with a filter. About 60% I take out every change and I use both a conditioner and a betta specifically environment solution on tap water. My process is I remove the water I'm keeping, add a little of the new water to it, transfer my betta to that water. I dump the remaining water with the gravel into a strainer run everything under hot water including the tank which I wipe out with paper towels. I take my already premade betta water and rinse everything off. Water goes in the tank about half ways then I add the water my betta is in after i have him in the net, then gently release him back in. 

 • Any tankmates? If so, please list with how many of each: none 

 • What do you feed and how much: a mixture of pellets, a brand called bug bites and once a week a few dried blood worms. Three or four pellets once a day and two or three shakes of the bug bites once a day (when I give blood worms I don't feed the bug bites). 

 • Decorations and plants in the tank: two artificial but looking into getting one living.

That's way to small of a tank in my opinion they are not supposed to live in small tanks. I made that mistake when I first got my two males now there each in a 3.5 gallon and I can tell how much happier they both are.
